content.title: Festo 401-3234 Pneumatic Globe Valve, 2-Way, Flanged Connection
content.short_description: Festo 401-3234 is a pneumatically actuated 2-way globe valve with a flanged connection, used for on/off or throttling control in fluid handling systems.
content.long_description:
The Festo 401-3234 is a globe-style valve designed for pneumatic actuation within industrial fluid handling systems. Its 2-way port configuration allows for straightforward inline flow control, suitable for applications requiring shutoff or flow regulation.

The valve body connects via a flanged interface, allowing secure mounting to mating pipe flanges without requiring threaded or welded joints. This connection type facilitates maintenance access and alignment during installation or replacement.

As a globe valve, the internal flow path is designed for throttling and regulating service, distinguishing it from ball or gate valves used primarily for full on/off shutoff. Pneumatic actuation enables remote or automated operation, integrating with compressed air control systems common in industrial process lines.

This component falls under the Industrial Components > Fluid Handling > Industrial Valves category and is identified by Festo MPN 401-3234.
